documents.title: msingi-leave-policy
documents.summary: This document outlines Msingi Foods' leave policies and expense procedures. It specifies annual leave allowances for different staff, details sick leave entitlements, and explains how to claim fuel expenses and seek approval for large spending.
documents.added: Wairimu Njoroge added this on 20 November 2026.
